h1: Custom Full Color Medals for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Medals | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color medals in bulk. Perfect for events, awards, and recognition. Get a quote today at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Full color medals let you reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with vivid detail, making them ideal for corporate awards, charity races, and school events. Unlike single-color or engraved medals, full color decoration captures gradients and small text clearly on the medal surface. The Laurel Wreath Medal is a popular example, combining classic shape with vibrant branding. Choose from ribbon colors and attachment options to match your event theme.
heroAltText: Custom full color medals with detailed logo and ribbon, perfect for awards and recognition events.
